messages:
maya-billing: Heads-up: customer ClearWave (CW-77) hit 3 consecutive card declines on auto-pay for INV-2026-701. Processor returned 'card_on_hold' + decline code 202.
derek-support: Opening ticket now. Customer says bank put a fraud hold; theycontacted the bank. They asked if we can accept a wire today to avoid suspension.
sophie-payments: System shows token state = suspended_by_issuer. We attempted a single automated retry which failed. payments-bot blocked further retries.
payments-bot: Auto-retries suspended for instrument cw-card-77 due to issuer_hold. No further attempts scheduled.
maya-billing: Invoice balance = $3,120. Proposal: accept a manual wire and offer one-time short-term grace (48h) pending funds. Need approval for grace > $1k.
sam-sales: Customer is strategic; approve up to $4k grace to avoid churn. I'll get them to sign a short authorization.
marta-legal: Send a one-page authorization for temporary grace and a statement that wire will satisfy invoice. I'll prepare DocuSign.
sophie-payments: Operational note: when wire lands, we mark invoice PAID and cancel any collection workflows. If they update card successfully first, we'll void the wire.
derek-support: Draft to customer: "We can accept a one-time wire to cover INV-2026-701 and will apply a 48-hour grace while funds clear. Please reply to accept and we will send wire details and the authorization for signature."
maya-billing: Wire instructions (internal template - redact before sending):
```
Bank: Redwood Commercial
Acct: 987654321
Routing: 026009593
Ref: CW-77-INV-701
```
sam-sales: Sending message + will ask for screenshot of bank hold and sign auth.
marta-legal: DocuSign sent at 1800123550. Must be signed before we apply grace.
derek-support: Customer signed at 1800123605 and says they've initiated a same-day wire.
sophie-payments: Applying provisional grace code GRACE-CW-3120. Temp hold expiry set for 48h.
payments-bot: Timer scheduled: temp_grace_expiry_1800125432 (48h).
maya-billing: Marking invoice state = awaiting_wire. Do not mark paid until funds clear.
sophie-payments: Wire received and matched at 1800123699. Posting payment and reversing provisional grace. Invoice marked PAID.
payments-bot: GL entry posted: PAY-2026-923. Temporary grace reversed.
marta-legal: Adding signed auth to contract notes.
sam-sales: Customer confirmed service never interrupted. Good save.
maya-billing: Filing brief FIN-3618 to add clearer UI copy about issuer holds and wire fallback flow. Closing thread.
